Name: Luny's Vanilla Swirl Body Retexture plus Custom Skin Tones
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3Ffvnd3.png[/img]﻿
[center]I've finally finished it! ◝(⁰▿⁰)◜Or at least finished it enough to upload... (￣▽￣*)ゞ There may be a few issues to fix, or maybe not. I've been
using this for a while now and haven't noticed anything yet, but different outfits/colors/emotes/etc might display errors that I haven't found.
If you do find any issues, leave a comment to let me know and I'll look into it.


This body type was designed to be just a glow-up from vanilla with minimal changes to the body shape to maintain compatibility with 
vanilla outfits and Fashion Sense creations. [b]The main changes are [/b][b]to the shoes (which use the sprites from my Small Boots for All mod), 
built-in blush (which can toggled off in config.json), changes to the arm sprites to be a little cuter, and the color of most built-in items
(such as jars when drinking, the flute and harp when playing them, etc)[/b][b] to match my Rose Iridium Tools set. I also redrew the swimsuit
sprites to be a little cuter. ♡ Oh, and the eyes also have a pixel of shading for better depth.

[color=#ead1dc]IMPORTANT[/color]: [/b]After changing options in GMCM, some changes may not display correctly until the game is relaunched. I suggest
making your changes at the title screen menu, then relaunching to ensure the sprites are loaded properly. Or make your
changes via the config.json.

[b][u][color=#ead1dc]NOTES:[/color][/u][/b]
The Chubby body type may have clipping issues with pants during certain animation frames. I tried to keep them close to the vanilla poses to mitigate this, but a little clipping may be unavoidable.
The Curvy body type is still a work in progress. You can select it now for the swimsuit body sprite, but the base body type will default to Vanilla Style in that case.


[b]Things I plan to add:[/b]
[color=#00ffff]☆[/color] Vanilla color option for the built-in items.
[color=#00ffff]☆[/color] More shoe styles.
[color=#00ffff]☆[/color] Built in replacement for vanilla pants & skirts that are refit to the new body types.
[color=#00ffff]☆[/color] Vitiligo skin option.
[color=#00ffff]☆[/color] More body types.

[b]Finished Additions:[/b]
[color=#ff00ff]♡[/color] Added the option to choose between vanilla style sleeves or sleeveless.
[color=#ff00ff]♡[/color] Three body type options for the swimsuit sprites.
[color=#ff00ff]♡[/color] Added option for no shoes, aka barefoot. 
[color=#ff00ff]♡[/color] Chubby body option is now available!
[color=#ff00ff]♡[/color] Curvy body option is complete!
[color=#ff00ff]♡[/color] No nose option to match the Slightly Cuter Aesthetic option.[/center]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/B92L7co.png[/img][center]
﻿Unzip the file and drop the folder into your StardewValley/mods folder.
Requires Content Patcher to work!






Thank you for checking out my mods!
